review:
Gothic vampires on a 5x4 grid with up to 1,024 ways. High-paying characters can turn into vampires, powered by Blood Reel multipliers.

In the first bonus (10 free spins), Blood Reels stick around and their multipliers change every spin – applying only to vampire symbols. The Dark Awakening bonus asks you to collect as many multipliers above each reel as possible using sticky coffins before time runs out. Rated 4/5, 10,000x max, top RTP 96.24%.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 88.25% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
